title: Forevermore
lyrics:
[00:55.87]Empty days
[00:58.63]To every day I want everyone to know
[01:09.06]What I found roaming around
[01:15.45]To bless me while I'm alive
[01:21.38]That's without a doubt
[01:26.31]And through separate ways
[01:30.92]Desperately facing everyone around
[01:37.51]I had a dream that we would meet
[01:44.22]And go places beyond what we've seen
[01:49.95]Keep my heart with you from now
[01:52.92]Forevermore
